task: ADR-030 (Resource Management Plan Standard): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Tier 3 resource contract downstream of Scope and Schedule, with no dependents: role catalogue with an accountable human, allocation on the Schedule timebox, agent work boundaries that cannot hold an ADR-001 or ADR-008 decision, and tooling assets. Floors and caps stay at the ADR-012 defaults, 150/600 and 800/5000. The learner advise-resource-plan-decision keeps Procurement and HR logits separate.
Two alternatives rejected: treating agents as unmanaged tooling, and folding resources into the Schedule plan.
Names visible over-allocation and unowned tooling, and the cost: capacity figures need an evidence basis that small teams may find heavy.
Section 8 clarifies agent capacity units and records that Cost does not depend on Resource. Section 4.5 leaves the team charter as an open question. Domain re-basing stays open.

evidence.source: direct_doc_read:docs/adr/ADR-030-resource-management-plan-standard.md sections 4.2-4.5 and 5; plan-specific note keeps department logits unblended
no fundamental flaw found in direct_doc_read of ADR-030
residual: team charter is a guide output this ADR does not adopt, and section 4.5 leaves it open rather than deciding it
adr_030_section_6 has two alternatives, both real
